zh: 这两天，我在几个AI群里转发了我的视频。
en: These past two days, I shared my videos in several AI groups.

zh: 有群友问了我一句：你才150个粉丝，
en: Someone in a group asked me: You only have 150 followers.

zh: 怎么变现？
en: How are you going to monetize?

zh: 说实话，这句话也不难回答，因为结果就摆在这儿。
en: Honestly, that question is not hard to answer. The result is right here.

zh: 粉丝不多，我也没有能证明稳定变现的结果。
en: I do not have many followers or a stable monetization result to prove.

zh: 没有结果的时候，你用什么判断自己该继续还是该停？
en: When there is no result yet, how do you decide whether to continue or stop?

zh: 很多人学AI，工具装了一堆，课听了一堆。
en: Many people learn AI, install many tools, and take many courses.

zh: 项目也做了，视频也发了，可客户没来。
en: They build projects and post videos, but no clients arrive.

zh: 钱没挣到，数据也不好。
en: They make no money, and the numbers look poor.

zh: 这个时候，人最容易走两个极端。
en: At this point, people often go to one of two extremes.

zh: 要么被别人的一句话劝退，
en: Either they quit after one comment,

zh: 或者用“坚持就会成功”安慰自己。
en: or comfort themselves by saying persistence guarantees success.

zh: 我觉得这两种判断都不够。150个粉丝只能说明
en: I do not think either judgment is enough. 150 followers only means

zh: 我现在还没有拿到流量结果，不能证明方向一定错，
en: I have not achieved a traffic result yet. It does not prove the direction is wrong,

zh: 也不能证明方向一定对。
en: and it does not prove the direction is right.

zh: 真正要看的是：每天做完一件事，到底留下了什么。
en: What matters is what remains after you finish something each day.

zh: 我现在会给自己留两本账。第一本，结果账。
en: I now keep two ledgers. The first is the results ledger.

zh: 视频有多少人看，有没有人收藏。
en: How many watched, and did anyone save it?

zh: 有没有真实咨询。
en: Did any real inquiries come in?

zh: 做一个AI方案，有没有人愿意试。
en: For an AI proposal, is anyone willing to try it?

zh: 谁来验收，有没有人愿意付费。
en: Who will validate it, and is anyone willing to pay?

zh: 这本账很现实，不能躲。
en: This ledger is practical. You cannot avoid it.

zh: 第二本账，是资产账：今天遇到了什么真实问题？
en: The second is the asset ledger: What real problem did I face today?

zh: 我是怎么判断的？做了什么？
en: How did I judge it, and what did I do?

zh: 哪里失败了？最后留下什么下次还能用的东西？
en: Where did I fail, and what remains that I can use next time?

zh: 我把每天看到的参考视频，
en: I put the reference videos I see each day,

zh: 真实项目里的交流、做错的判断
en: real project conversations, and wrong judgments

zh: 和复盘，陆续放进自己的知识库。
en: along with reviews into my personal knowledge base.

zh: 下次写口播、做方案、再去见企业时，AI调用的
en: Next time I write, design a proposal, or meet a business, AI can retrieve

zh: 不只是通用答案，还有我做过、错过、改过的记录。
en: not only generic answers, but records of what I did, missed, and changed.

zh: 过去，这些东西可能只是一堆笔记。
en: In the past, these might have been only a pile of notes.

zh: 现在，当AI能检索、结合、重新调用它们时，
en: Now, when AI can retrieve, combine, and reuse them,

zh: 它们就有机会在选题、方案和交付里被一次次放大。
en: they can be amplified across topics, proposals, and delivery.

zh: 这才是我理解的数字资产。
en: That is what I mean by digital assets.

zh: 但这里要说清楚：不是你发过一条视频，
en: But let me be clear: posting a video does not mean

zh: 存过一份文档，它就自动值钱。
en: or saving a document does not make it valuable automatically.

zh: 虚假的、重复的、没有来源的、存完再也不用的东西，
en: False, repeated, unsourced, and never-reused material

zh: 堆得再多，也是数字垃圾。
en: is still digital waste, no matter how much you collect.

zh: 真正可能产生复利的是四样东西：
en: Four things may genuinely compound over time:

zh: 一个真实问题、你自己的判断、一段行动过程，
en: a real problem, your own judgment, and an action process,

zh: 一个结果或者失败。
en: plus a result or a failure.

zh: 真实才有价值，能找到才能调用，反复用才会变成资产。
en: Truth creates value. Retrieval enables use. Reuse turns it into an asset.

zh: 所以落地不是做一个自己觉得很牛的AI产品，
en: Execution is not building an AI product that only you think is impressive,

zh: 然后等合伙人、等投资人来发现你。
en: then waiting for a partner or investor to discover you.

zh: 你得自己走进场景，找人验证：方案有没有人用？
en: You must enter the real setting and validate whether anyone uses the proposal.

zh: 为什么？
en: Why or why not?

zh: 数据拿不到，卡在哪里？谁不愿意验收？
en: If data is unavailable, where is it blocked? Who will not validate it?

zh: 哪一步只是你自己觉得好？哪怕最后没有成交，
en: Which step only looks good to you? Even if no deal closes,

zh: 只要拿到一个真实拒绝原因，改掉一次错误判断，
en: a real rejection reason and one corrected judgment still matter.

zh: 也比在群里讨论十次“AI落地”更值钱。
en: That is worth more than discussing AI execution ten times in a group.

zh: 《道德经》里有句话：“明道若昧，进道若退。”
en: The Tao Te Ching says: A clear way may seem obscure; progress may seem like retreat.

zh: 真正往上走的时候，体感有时确实像在后退。
en: When you truly move upward, it can sometimes feel like moving backward.

zh: 因为你开始承认：学会工具，不等于有人付钱。
en: You begin to admit that learning a tool does not mean someone will pay.

zh: 做出产品，不等于市场需要；发了视频，也不等于有流量。
en: Building a product does not prove demand; posting a video does not ensure traffic.

zh: 这当然会让人怀疑自己。但怀疑不是坏事。
en: This can make you doubt yourself. But doubt is not a bad thing.

zh: 只要它变成一次检查、一次调整、下一次行动，
en: If it becomes one check, one adjustment, and the next action,

zh: 它就是反馈。
en: then it becomes feedback.

zh: 最怕的是一边怀疑，一边什么都不做。
en: The real danger is doubting while doing nothing.

zh: 或者每天重复昨天，还把它叫坚持。
en: Or repeating yesterday every day and calling it persistence.

zh: 150个粉丝不值得炫耀，也没必要因此否定自己。
en: 150 followers are nothing to boast about, but no reason to deny yourself.

zh: 它只是今天的一组数字。
en: It is only a number today.

zh: 到了AI时代，我判断，真正会越来越值钱的是
en: In the AI era, I believe what will grow more valuable is

zh: 的那一部分：你真实而连续的个人上下文。
en: that missing part: your real and continuous personal context.

zh: 你做过什么，怎么判断，为什么改，又在哪里失败？
en: What did you do, how did you judge, why did you change, and where did you fail?

zh: 这些东西积累得越真实、越清楚、越能重新调用，
en: The more truthful, clear, and reusable these records become,

zh: 你和别人之间的差异才会越来越具体。
en: the more concrete your difference from others becomes.

zh: 今天就开始建你的知识库。别用一句坚持骗自己，
en: Start building your knowledge base today. Do not fool yourself with persistence,

zh: 也别让一句“你才150个粉丝”把你劝退。
en: and do not let the words only 150 followers make you quit.

zh: 我是超哥，我在兰州AI创业。
en: I am Chao, building an AI venture in Lanzhou.
